findings.issue: Saved record is serialized before checkpoint_sha256 is appended. Reused records lack the SHA field; mixed reused/new CSV rows can raise extra-field ValueError.
findings.fix: Recompute checkpoint_sha256 on returning a reused checkpoint; keep sidecar consistent.

findings.issue: Timing recreates/copies gallery prototypes inside each measured call. Values include gallery conversion/copy and differ from a resident-gallery query latency.
findings.fix: Hoist gallery tensor before timing, or report exactly that this overhead is included. Scores unaffected.

findings.issue: Cache done markers are trusted based on existence; model/manifest/code fingerprints are not checked on reuse. Current same-protocol run is not invalidated, but later reruns can silently mix old caches after edits.
findings.fix: Bind reused cache markers/progress to split/protocol, weights and extraction-code fingerprint, or explicitly require cache rebuild when those change.
